crossRefs.note: These are the garments which they shall make: a breastplate, an ephod, a robe, a fitted tunic, a turban, and a sash.…
You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of…
They shall have linen turbans on their heads, and shall have linen trousers on their waists. They shall not clothe…
You shall make them linen pants to cover their naked flesh. They shall reach from the waist even to the thighs.

translations.web: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,
translations.bsb: as well as the turban of fine linen, the ornate headbands and undergarments of finely spun linen,
translations.kjv: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
translations.asv: and the mitre of fine linen, and the goodly head-tires of fine linen, and the linen breeches of fine twined linen,
